final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: Energy class C or better, as explicitly requested by the user. Geographic (Turin, near public transport), funding (CDP/PNRR), surface (850 sqm) and bed-count (60) requirements are not covered by the available columns and are excluded from this output.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The office typology is the current physical state, so the conversion to student residence is not used for typology filtering.
User requires the building to be near public transport. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.

A university student residence is inherently tied to universities, so proximity to schools and universities is necessary. Set to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude, and mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the reference point. No LIMIT applied. The CDP/PNRR program and the 60-bed capacity are not translated into predicates because no agent supplied them as extracted requirements.
